description_en: Creates a real-time recording template for submitting real-time recording tasks
description_zh: 调用CreateLiveRecordTemplate创建实时录制模板，便于提交实时录制任务
kebab_example: aliyun ice create-live-record-template --record-format Format=m3u8 SliceOssObjectPrefix=record/_JobId_/_UnixTimestamp_Sequence CycleDuration=3600 SliceDuration=30 OssObjectPrefix=record/_JobId_/_Sequence_EscapedStartTime_EscapedEndTime --name example-string --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateLiveRecordTemplate

fields.help_en:
The cycle recording duration. Unit: seconds. If this parameter is not specified, the default value is 6 hours.

If a live stream is interrupted during a recording cycle but resumes within 3 minutes, the recording continues in the same recording file.
A live stream must be interrupted for more than 3 minutes before the last recording file is generated. If you need to modify the default 3-minute interruption time, submit a ticket
fields.help_zh:
周期录制时长。单位：秒。不填则默认为6小时。

如果在一个录制周期内，直播流发生了断流，但是在3分钟内，该直播流又正常推流，那么仍会在同一个录制文件中继续录制。
一条直播流必须断流超过3分钟，才会生成最后一个录制文件。如果您需要修改默认的3分钟断流时间，可以提交工单进行修改
fields.name: cycle_duration

fields.help_en:
The format.

If you select the m3u8 format, you must also set the request parameters SliceOssObjectPrefix and SliceDuration
fields.help_zh:
格式。

如果选择m3u8格式，必须同时设置请求参数SliceOssObjectPrefix和SliceDuration
fields.name: format
oss_object_prefix

fields.help_en:
The duration of a single slice. Unit: seconds.
This parameter takes effect only when Format is set to m3u8.

If this parameter is not specified, the default value is 30 seconds. Valid values: 5 to 30
fields.help_zh:
单个切片时长。单位：秒。
当Format（格式）设为m3u8时，本参数才有效。

不填则默认为30秒。取值范围：5s~30s
fields.name: slice_duration

fields.help_en:
The name of the TS slice.

This parameter is required only when Format is set to m3u8.

The default slice duration is 30 seconds. The name must be less than 256 bytes and supports variable matching, including {JobId}, {UnixTimestamp}, and {Sequence}.
The parameter value must contain the {UnixTimestamp} and {Sequence} variables
fields.help_zh:
TS切片名称。

当Format（格式）设为m3u8时，本参数才需要配置。

默认30秒一片，小于256字节，支持变量匹配，包含{JobId}、{UnixTimestamp}、{Sequence}。
参数值必须包含{UnixTimestamp}和{Sequence}变量
fields.name: slice_oss_object_prefix
